sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:42

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:42:1
items.html: The light of Ein Sof descended and broke through within them from above downward: This refers to the new light that descended and breached the Parsa and brought the light to the Nekudim, as above in the words of the ARI. And breaching means the annulment of the boundary, as above.
